subject: Quick ops demo to walk through recent usage spike
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenlabs.io>, Priya Sethi <priya@lumenlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ops demo to walk through recent usage spike

Hi Jordan / Priya —

I noticed Lumen Labs crossed our "promoted usage" threshold yesterday (roughly 180k tokens/day). Congrats on the traction — that's exactly the moment teams usually appreciate a short ops walkthrough so we can:

- make sure batching / KV cache settings are preventing token spikes from adding latency,
- confirm quantization profile is a good fit for your latency targets, and
- surface a quick mitigation plan if the growth would push you into throttles.

Would 20–30 minutes next week work for a short run-through? I can cover the operational checklist and Ben (our inference specialist) can join if you want a deeper technical look. Two slots I have open:

- Tue May 7, 09:30–10:00 PT
- Wed May 8, 13:00–13:30 PT

If those don't work, send over a couple times and I’ll sync up. I attached a 1-page checklist that outlines what we'll cover — helps keep the call focused.

Calendly: https://cal.com/redwood/quick-ops (link also in signature)

Thanks,

— Kimberly Park
SDR, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.ai/docs/quick-ops

-- Attachment: brief_ops_checklist.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ops demo to walk through recent usage spike

Thanks Kimberly — this is great.

We'd appreciate a slightly longer session (30 minutes) so our engineering lead can hop on. Tue May 7 at 09:30 PT works for us if Ben can join.

Two quick asks before the call:
- Can you include a very short agenda in the invite (ops checks + any quick mitigation steps)?
- If there's anything we should pull from our side (logs, example prompt sets), let us know and we'll share ahead of time.

(Quoted message below)

Perfect — thanks, Jordan.

I’ll set this as a 30-minute slot for Tue May 7 at 09:30 PT and include a short agenda:

Agenda (30m)
- 5m quick context from Lumen Labs (what you're seeing)
- 15m ops review (batching, KV cache, sequence-length patterns, quantization)
- 8m mitigation & next steps (MVP changes + owner)
- 2m confirm follow-ups / Mx plan

Ben, I’m tagging you to join as the technical lead. If you can bring a quick checklist of the logs or exports you want (trace + sample prompts), I’ll ask Lumen Labs to share them before the call.

Jordan / Priya — attaching a draft mutual action plan so we can capture owners during the call. If you want to push to a different time, tell me and I’ll move the invite.

Thanks — invite shortly.

— Kimberly

-- Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 2 sheets)
